verdict.rationale: Warp's docs describe the Oz CLI as a tool for running and managing agents from any terminal, script, or CI pipeline without the desktop app. They also cover API keys for non-interactive authentication on CI pipelines, headless servers, and containers, plus cloud agents triggered by webhooks, GitHub events, or schedules, with auditable run transcripts. A probe confirms the CLI reference and an OpenAPI spec exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI runs (all evidence is vendor documentation).
